notes: cics-crucible commarea-mismatch / ca-address-commarea, CAADSB entered directly (the #7426 pattern): the callee of CAADDR mode L run as the root program so its own coverage is measured (a LINKed callee is capped at L2, #4270). The oracle is GnuCOBOL plus the stub.

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: ADDRESS COMMAREA gives X'FF000000', the ABSENT arm

scenarios.name: link-view
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 20 (EYE PING, REQUEST CHECK-ME, REPLY blank): ADDRESS COMMAREA gives the caller's bytes, the PRESENT arm; the program reads the view and writes PONG through it (#7589, the det port takes the bytes as the link area)
